threads.body: [General] `--no-daemon` disables only the Gradle daemon. The warm-up build above can leave a separate Kotlin compiler daemon running before CodeQL is initialized, and these commands use matching Kotlin daemon arguments, so they can reconnect to that untraced process. That can leave the manual Kotlin database empty or incomplete; force compilation into the traced Gradle process (or otherwise prevent reuse of the pre-init Kotlin daemon).

threads.body: [General] These two `-p` builds do not read the repository-root `gradle.properties`, so the 8 GiB heap configured above is not applied. With Kotlin now compiling in-process, the verified run used Gradle's 512 MiB default and stopped during `gradle-plugins:compileKotlin` because the GC was thrashing; the Kotlin analysis therefore never ran. Pass an adequate `org.gradle.jvmargs` value to both nested builds (or otherwise configure their project roots) so in-process compilation has the intended heap.
